RAAST QR TENDER + BANK-SMS MATCHING — BUILD SPEC (servd, 2026-10-12)

=== 0. BINDING DESIGN DECISIONS ===
D1 Tender. New PaymentMethod 'raast' and PaymentGateway 'raast'. 'keenu_qr' is RETIRED: kept in the Postgres enum (values cannot be dropped), never written by new code; old rows stay readable/reportable; an old keenu_qr sale is refunded by keenu_qr exactly as before. Ring-up (POST /pos/orders) and POST /pos/quote accept 'keenu_qr' only as a legacy alias of the digital rate (mapped to 'raast') so an offline-queued pre-deploy ring-up never 400s. Payments, settles, splits, quotes-for-payment and intents refuse it: 422 KEENU_QR_RETIRED 'Keenu QR is retired — take Raast QR or Card – Keenu'. Tills show exactly: Cash, Card – Keenu, Raast QR (+ Staff meal, Comp).
D2 Tax. lib/pricing Tender 'card' IS the digital tax group (card + Raast) -> Concept.taxRateCard (8%). Add 'raast' to CARD_TENDERS (keep 'keenu_qr' for legacy reads). No rename of Tender / PreBill.tender / fiscal payment.mode 'card'; UI labels say 'Card / Raast (8%)'. Never concept.taxRate.
D3 Sale vs truth. A Raast payment completes the sale at the till exactly like card (Payment.status 'paid' -> applyCoverageTx -> completeOrder -> FnF bill, the ONE fiscal sale document, loyalty; ledger at shift close / order.complete). 'provisional -> matched' is the reconciliation state of a new RaastReceipt row (bank-statement line = truth), never Payment.status.
D4 Ledger. Raast money debits the receiving BANK account's chart code (BankAccount.accountCode, snapshotted on the receipt as ledgerCode when recorded); Raast refunds credit that code; never 1030. Till sales post at the shift close (aggregated per code), non-till orders at order.complete. Every posting via postJournalEntry with the source document's tenantId, balanced, period-lock respected.
D5 SMS. Inside the existing POS connector module: PosConnector(kind 'raast') per company; its `enabled` = bank-SMS matching ON (default OFF; the CEO switches it on after a readiness check). Device tokens in a new table: secretBox ciphertext + SHA-256 lookup hash, created/rotated by CONNECTOR_ADMINS (admin, it). No new module id — Dev -> API stays exactly api_whatsapp + api_pos.
D6 Future bank API. Matching consumes a normalised BankCredit; the SMS parser is one producer. A later 'http' driver (RAAST_DRIVERS registry; webhook event 'raast.credit' on the existing /webhooks/pos/:token with HMAC; a dynamic QR whose bill reference = RaastReceipt.id) is another producer — no rework of intents, receipts, matching, ledger or UI. v1 builds the types + registry slot only, not the http driver.
D7 Gates (no GATED_PREFIXES change): till /pos/raast/* (CASHIERS, ungated like /pos/terminal/*), IT /connectors/raast/* (api_pos), finance /reconciliation/raast/* (reconciliation), receiving accounts /setup/* (FINANCE_TEAM), tender report /reports/by-tender (reports). The connector page gets bank-account choices from its OWN overview (IT cannot call /setup/bank-accounts).
D8 Company separation from the first commit: every new row carries tenantId from its source document (receipt <- order.concept.tenantId; device <- activeTenantId at creation; alert <- device.tenantId). Unique keys per company, except BankSmsDevice.tokenHash (a credential, globally unique like PosConnector.webhookToken — comment it). Foreign ids 404; cross-company attach on create 422; empty scope denies.
D9 Fraud rule. Raast is verified on the COUNTER device (merchant app / bank SMS), never the customer's screen; the till says so on every Raast screen and the cashier must tick an attestation when typing a reference (server-enforced `raastVerified: true`).

=== 1. SCHEMA + MIGRATIONS (Stream S — orchestrator, FIRST, serial) ===
Migration 1 backend/prisma/migrations/20261012130000_raast_enum_values/migration.sql (own migration: a new enum value cannot be used in the transaction that adds it — precedent 20261010210000):
  ALTER TYPE "PaymentMethod"  ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'raast';
  ALTER TYPE "PaymentGateway" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'raast';
  ALTER TYPE "ConnectorKind"  ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'raast';
Migration 2 backend/prisma/migrations/20261012130100_raast_tender/migration.sql: the enums/columns/tables below, FKs, indexes, plus two SQL-only partial unique indexes:
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "raast_receipts_one_awaiting_per_order" ON "raast_receipts" ("orderId") WHERE "status" = 'awaiting';
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "bank_accounts_one_raast_default_per_company" ON "bank_accounts" ("tenantId") WHERE "raastDefault" = true AND "deletedAt" IS NULL;
Nothing dropped/renamed, no backfill (no Raast data exists), IF NOT EXISTS guards. tests/setup.ts: re-create both partial indexes after db push (next to terminal_charges_one_active_per_order).

result.risks:
1. Fake bank SMS / leaked device token: anyone holding a token can POST a forged credit and complete a bill. Mitigations: per-device bearer token (hash lookup, rotate, deactivate), sender allow-list, exact amount + time window + exactly one candidate, per-company unique reference, SMS-confirmed receipts stay provisional, statement match within N days, raast_unconfirmed / raast_unmatched flags. Prefer the Authorization header; the path-token fallback leaks into proxy/Cloudflare logs.
2. Bank OTPs: the SIM that receives Raast alerts usually also receives internet-banking OTPs from the same sender ID. servd drops keyword-matched and non-allow-listed messages without storing them, but the counter phone itself is an OTP interception risk — the owner should use an alert-only number with no internet-banking login on it.
3. Cashier fraud (fake reference typed, cash pocketed) and customer screenshot fraud: attestation tick, reference format + per-company uniqueness, SMS cross-check (when ON), statement truth, write-off with approvers. With SMS OFF the gap until the statement import is days.
4. Double counting at reconciliation: the shift close debits the bank with a per-shift Raast aggregate; individual Raast statement credits are matched to receipts, not journal lines. If finance 'adjusts' an unmatched Raast credit instead of matching it, the money is booked twice. Mitigated by the Raast pre-pass, the generic matcher's RAAST memo exclusion and a UI warning — needs finance training.
5. Money-critical rewrites: processPayment/settlePayment/refunds, the LEDGER-R5 cancel unwind (park by account code instead of tender class), buildSaleLines and the shift close. Regression risk on cancelled-ticket hand-backs and 1110 netting — run the existing LEDGER-R5, terminal, fiscal and till suites; orchestrator reviews personally.
6. Two copies of the reference: Payment.gatewayRef and RaastReceipt.bankRef (the per-company unique claim). Must only be written together (recordRaastReceiptTx and the reference-fix routes) or they drift.
7. Prisma P2002 on raast_receipts(tenantId, bankRef) inside an interactive transaction aborts it — needs a pre-check plus catch-and-map to 409 outside $transaction.
8. Partial unique indexes are SQL-only (one awaiting intent per order; one default Raast account per company) — tests/setup.ts must re-create them or the race tests pass on a weaker schema. New enum values need their own migration.
9. keenu_qr retirement: old pending keenu_qr split portions cannot be settled (re-split); offline-queued ring-ups carrying keenu_qr are aliased; existing tests that pay keenu_qr (ordersReconcile.test.ts:243) and exact health keys (healthConnectors.test.ts:28) break until updated.
10. Paisa amounts: 8% GST produces paisa (e.g. PKR 1,332.72); a customer who rounds up breaks exact-amount auto-matching and lands in the cashier's manual queue (tolerance is 2 paisa).
11. Template parser: bank formats unknown until the bank is chosen; a format change at the bank turns every SMS 'unparsed' (flagged, deduped per sender). Templates are a servd-compiled DSL with bounded sub-patterns (no user regex, no ReDoS); body length capped.
12. Concurrency: SMS vs manual confirm vs another SMS on the same intent — handled by the per-company advisory lock, the order lock, the awaiting->provisional claim and the unique reference; forwarder retries deduped by bodyHash (including the device timestamp — two genuine identical texts at the same second without a reference would collapse; credit templates require {ref}).
13. Ledger snapshot: a receipt's ledgerCode is fixed at payment time; if finance deactivates that chart account before the shift closes, the close is refused (flagged posting_failed) — intended, but needs finance awareness.
14. Rollback below this release: older code books any 'raast' row as card (1030) and refuses raast tenders; do not roll back once a Raast sale exists without a manual 1030 -> bank reclass. Same secretBox caveat as the other connector secrets: losing SERVD_SECRET_KEY means devices must be re-created.
15. PII: SMS bodies carry payer names/partial account numbers — visible to CEO/IT/finance only (cashiers see payer + amount + ref for 48 h), purged after 90 days (unparsed 30).
16. Health noise: forwarders only post when an SMS arrives, so silence at night is normal — no 'device silent' warning by design; a dead phone during trading shows up as intents expiring and unconfirmed-reference flags instead.
17. Socket rooms are best-effort; the till must keep its poll fallback or an SMS-completed bill could look stuck.
18. Shared files: index.ts (workers), CLAUDE.md and prisma schema are integrated by the orchestrator only; streams must not touch each other's files.

amendments.problem: §6.5 step 4 race. An SMS is processed under the per-company advisory lock, but the cashier's POST /pos/raast/intents/:id/confirm (and POST /pos/payments with a typed ref) never takes that lock. So step 1 can find no receipt with the bankRef and step 3 can find the intent 'awaiting', while the cashier's transaction is still uncommitted. processPayment then waits on lockOrderTx and comes back ALREADY_PAID or RAAST_INTENT_GONE. The spec maps any AppError refusal to 'receipt needs_attention (attentionReason=code)'. That overwrites the receipt the cashier just made provisional with a paymentId. Every reader that filters on provisional|matched then drops a paid sale: chooseRaastRefundSourceTx, the statement pre-pass (provisional|unreceived) and the flags. The alert also goes needs_attention instead of 'confirmed'.
amendments.change: In applyBankCredit, before marking anything after a refusal, re-read the receipt and order under the lock. If the receipt is now provisional or matched with an equal amount, run the step-1 path instead (linkAlertTx 'confirmed', smsConfirmedAt). Only write needs_attention with a conditional updateMany where status IN ('awaiting') and the id matches, never an unconditional update by id. Make every Raast write path take the same per-company lock first: cashier confirm, POST /pos/payments raast, attach, the reference fix and intent cancel/expiry. Add a test: cashier confirm and SMS for the same intent at the same moment leave one payment, the receipt provisional with smsAlertId set, and the alert 'confirmed'.

amendments.problem: §6.5 serialises applyBankCredit with pg_advisory_xact_lock and then calls processPayment/settlePayment in step 4. Those open their OWN prisma.$transaction on a second pooled connection and then run afterTillSale (completeOrder, fiscal filing, loyalty) after commit. The outer interactive transaction stays open across all of that. Prisma's default interactive-tx timeout is 5 s, while processPayment alone allows maxWait 10 s and timeout 15 s. If the outer transaction expires after the inner payment committed, the alert's 'matched' write is lost and the alert falls back to received/duplicate. Several companies' SMS in flight at once each hold one connection and wait for a second, which can starve the pool.
amendments.change: Do not hold an interactive transaction across processPayment. Option 1: in a short transaction (xact advisory lock, candidate search, atomically claim the intent with a 'settling' marker, e.g. smsAlertId set plus a lease timestamp, and the alert set to 'processing'), commit, then call processPayment/settlePayment with the intent id, then finish the alert in a second short transaction. Option 2: take a session-level pg_advisory_lock on a dedicated connection and release it in finally. Specify which one in §6.5. The processPayment intent claim must accept the 'settling' marker held by the same alert.

amendments.problem: Fraud hole in the cross-checks. findSmsForRefTx (§4.1) and step 1 (§6.5) match on (tenantId, bankRef) plus amount only. They do not check the alert's bankAccountId against the receipt's receiving account, the alert's age, or its status. So a reference from a credit a manager DISMISSED as 'not a sale' (supplier refund, owner transfer) can be typed by a cashier on a bill of the same amount. The receipt then shows as SMS-confirmed, the raast_unconfirmed flag never fires, and the statement pre-pass later matches it to that genuine non-sale credit. The cashier pockets the customer's cash and the books look clean. Credits on another of the company's bank accounts, 'debit' alerts and days-old 'off' alerts can be borrowed the same way. The finance PATCH /receipts/:id/reference (FINANCE_TEAM) can re-point a receipt the same way.
amendments.change: findSmsForRefTx, step 1 and the statement pre-pass may only use credit alerts and lines that meet all of these: kind credit; status in (received, processing, unmatched, ambiguous, off, needs_attention); bankAccountId equal to the receipt's bankAccountId; occurredAt within [receipt.createdAt − matchWindowMin, now]. If the ref belongs to a dismissed or debit alert of the company: 409 RAAST_REF_DISMISSED on the payment, and the statement pre-pass skips it. Persist dismissed refs as a per-company claim (e.g. a nullable BankSmsAlert.claimedRef with @@unique([tenantId, claimedRef]) checked together with RaastReceipt) so one transfer can never be both 'not a sale' and a sale. Move PATCH /reconciliation/raast/receipts/:id/reference to APPROVERS with the same checks, and audit before/after.

amendments.problem: matchOnIntentCreated auto-settles a new intent with an unmatched credit whose occurredAt is up to matchWindowMin (10 min) BEFORE the intent existed. That credit was by definition sent before this bill was put up for Raast. Typically it is another customer's payment for a bill the cashier never put in Raast mode, often at another location sharing the same receiving account and SIM. Auto-attaching it marks a bill paid whose customer has not paid, which the owner's 'never guess' rule forbids.
amendments.change: On intent creation, auto-settle only alerts with occurredAt >= intent.createdAt − clockSkewMin (2 min). amendments.problem: §7.1 runs the generic matcher after the Raast pre-pass over the same lines. A Raast credit whose reference is not found in the statement text falls through to it, and it pairs that credit with ANY equal-amount debit journal line on the bank code within 3 days (a cash deposit, a manual entry). The line becomes 'matched' to the wrong entry, so the Raast receipt can never be matched (POST /receipts/:id/match requires an unmatched line) and stays flagged as raast_unmatched. reconciliation/routes.ts has no route to undo a generic match.
